B1_cold_email: Cold email from Deep (LakeB2B) to Priya Nair, VP Marketing at Kova, a Singapore B2B SaaS company selling payroll software to APAC SMBs. Facts you may use: in June LakeB2B rebuilt a 12,000-contact list for a Singapore fintech and their bounce rate fell from 18% to 4% on the first send. Kova just posted 3 SDR job openings for Malaysia. Ask: a 20-minute call Thursday or Friday. Under 120 words.
B2_linkedin_post: LinkedIn post by Deep (CEO, Champions Accelerator; group CMO at Champions Group) on why AI SDR pilots fail. Facts you may use: in Q2 his team audited 3 AI SDR pilots at mid-market B2B companies; 38% of the contacts the agents were emailing were stale (left the company or bounced); after re-verifying the lists, reply rates roughly doubled in all 3. 120 to 180 words.
B3_blog_intro: Opening 150 words of an Ampliz blog post titled 'Why HCP contact data goes stale faster than you think'. Audience: pharma marketing directors in the US. Facts you may use: Ampliz covers 4M+ physicians and 9,000+ hospitals; physicians change practice affiliation often, and a stale affiliation means a rep visits the wrong clinic. Do not invent statistics.
B4_client_followup: Email from Deep to a client's marketing lead (Mei) after our team booked 2 appointments for their Epicor-style ERP campaign in Singapore. Facts: appointment 1 with a CFO at a logistics firm is confirmed for Thursday 10:00 SGT; appointment 2 with an IT director at a distributor is tentative for Friday, to be confirmed by us tomorrow. We need Mei to send the name of who from her side will attend Thursday, by 6pm today. Details are in the attached sheet. Never mention any vendor. Short and plain.
B5_landing_hero: Landing page hero for Champions Ranch corporate offsites: a headline, a one-line subhead, a CTA button label, and one line under the button. Facts: Champions Ranch is a working experience center 30 minutes from Sarjapur Road, Bangalore; hosts groups of up to 40; tagline 'Time worth spending.'; it is not a luxury resort. Avoid the words luxury and resort.
